title: Irregular Verbs
content: Regular verbs form their past and past participle by adding ed (d). Irregular verbs do not have definite rules, but there are a few patterns. [Quiz 13.1] Find the past and past participle forms of the following verbs using your dictionary: bring drink think tell eat make beat View Answers[13.1] brought – brought drank – drunk thought – thought told – told ate – eaten made – made beat – beaten
